  icon?: string;
  cta?: string;
  ctaHref?: string;
  layout?: "card" | "plain";
  actions?: "button" | "none";
  visual?: "icon" | "image";

import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";

  id,
  title,
  text,
  icon = "inbox",
  cta,
  ctaHref,

  actions = "button",
  visual = "icon",
  size = "default",

          (((layout as string) === 'plain') ? 'bg-transparent inset-ring-0' : ''),
          (((size as string) === 'compact') ? 'py-6' : '')

      >
        <template #action>
          <Button v-if="((actions as string) === 'button')" variant="default" size="sm" :href="urlOf(ctaHref)">
            {{ cta }}
